description: Large-margin cosine classification objective that subtracts a fixed margin from each sample's target cosine score, scales all class scores, and computes softmax cross entropy. Inputs are unscaled cosine similarities from normalized feature and class-weight vectors, following the CosFace paper §3.1, Eqs. (4)–(5).

examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def samples(ctx):
    label = int(ctx.index) % 3
    features = 0.1 * torch.randn(6, generator=ctx.rng.torch)
    features[label] += 1.0
    return {"features": synth.Tensor(features), "labels": label}
ds = synth.Spec("cosface-classification", generator=samples, size=24, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=7, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("tabular-classify", split="train")
class CosFaceClassifier(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = build("mlp", "tiny", in_features=6, out_features=4)
        self.class_weights = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(3, 4))
    def forward(self, features):
        embeddings = F.normalize(self.encoder(features), dim=-1)
        class_weights = F.normalize(self.class_weights, dim=-1)
        return F.linear(embeddings, class_weights)
trainer = Trainer(CosFaceClassifier(), train, recipe="tabular-classify", recipe_config={"loss": "cosface", "loss_kwargs": {"margin": 0.35, "scale": 64.0}}, batch_size=4, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()
examples.title: Train a cosine classifier with CosFace

name: CosFace large-margin cosine loss

parameters.additional parameters: none; unknown parameter names raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because ignored targets are unsupported
parameters.logits_or_prediction: unscaled cosine scores computed from L2-normalized feature and class-weight vectors, shaped [B, K]
parameters.margin: finite nonnegative additive cosine margin subtracted from the target class score (default 0.35; CosFace paper §4.2)
parameters.reduction: none per sample, mean, or sum (default mean)
parameters.scale: finite positive multiplier for all margin-adjusted cosine scores (default 64.0; CosFace paper §4.1)
parameters.targets: long tensor of class indices shaped [B], with values in [0, K)
